'''Kholes''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] space and the home of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] outpost. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], soon after an outbreak of [[Bledsoe's disease]] on the nearby planet [[Tay'ah'loo]], the Rebel outpost was wiped out by Imperial forces.
